tools.name: get_intake_questions
tools.description: Free. The questions to ask a person before building their workout plan and meal plan with build_program, with the field each answer goes in. Also lists the other MTFIT tools and prices.

tools.name: build_program
tools.description: Personalized workout plan, meal plan and macros from a real personal trainer's rules (coach Mat, MTFIT), not generic AI output, for fat loss, weight loss, recomp or muscle gain. Built from the rules coach Mat (MTFIT) uses with his in-person and online clients, backed by 10 years of his own training

tools.name: adjust_program
tools.description: Adjust a workout and nutrition plan after a check-in, the way a personal trainer would: weight loss stalled, strength stalled, too sore, missed workouts, low motivation, new pain, or block finished (next 6 week block). Changes calories, steps, sets, effort or training days. Send the program_state fr

tools.name: calculate_macros
tools.description: Calorie and macro calculator from a real personal trainer's rules (MTFIT): daily calories, protein, carbs and fat for fat loss / weight loss, recomp or muscle gain, with example meals and safe limits (calorie floors, capped deficits). No workout plan: use build_program for that. Metric or US units.

tools.name: swap_exercise
tools.description: Exercise substitution from a personal trainer's exercise library (MTFIT): get 1 to 3 alternatives for one exercise because of no equipment (gym, home dumbbells, bands or bodyweight), pain (shoulder, lower back), too hard, or variety.
